info.longBusinessSummary: Maximus, Inc. provides tech-enabled services to government agencies in the United States and internationally. It operates through three segments: U.S. Federal Services, U.S. Services, and Outside the U.S. The company offers clinical services, including independent assessments of benefit eligibility; medical disability examinations; arbitration, appeals support, and payment resolution; eligibility and enrollment, outreach, and other services for federal health and human services programs; and technology solutions comprising automated systems and upgrades, and integration and management of disparate systems and processes. It also provides program operations, contact centers, clinical services, employment services, advanced technology solutions, and related professional services; Accuracy AssistantSM, an AI-enabled accuracy platform, and independent verification and validation services that provide independent technology oversight to help ensure systems meet requirements; specialized services, such as services to assist clients in procurement, business process assessment and design, implementation, quality assurance, policy and procedure reviews, and management of systems and projects; and cost allocation services, as well as audit assistance, and grant and proposal reviews. In addition, the company offers health and disability assessments, program administration for employment services, wellbeing solutions and other job seeker-related services, digitally-enabled customer services, and advanced technologies; employment services; and digitally enabled customer contact centers and services, and wellbeing solutions, as well as technology solutions, including health care administration software. It serves federal government, state and local government, and specialized markets. Maximus, Inc. was founded in 1975 and is based in McLean, Virginia.
